The '''Covenant Shadow Database''' was the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] database in the [[Draay Estate]] that was used by the [[Jedi Covenant]] to keep track of [[Covenant Shadow]]s. This database was accessible only to a few individuals, including [[Haazen]] and [[Lucien Draay]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> It is possible that this database was destroyed during [[Vindication]] since the Draay Estate was destroyed and the list was never said to have been moved to another location.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 32" />
